blocks.text: Cut the cord with the sleek, portable HP X3000 G3 Wireless Mouse and enjoy the freedom to work or play untethered from almost anywhere. Enjoy effortless left or right-handed control with this multi-OS (1) compatible, wireless HP computer mouse, featuring 3-button operation and scroll wheel, plus 2.4 GHz wireless connectivity that keeps you connected to your laptop or desktop computer from up to 30-feet away. Smoothly work just about anywhere with LED multi-surface technology that delivers reliable mouse tracking on virtually any surface (2). And, thanks to its 1600 dpi optical sensor, this HP wireless mouse gives you precise, accurate control of every click and selection for greater speed and efficiency, whether you're manipulating spreadsheet data, editing photos, or playing the latest game. Take it with you wherever you go—the USB nano receiver conveniently stores inside the mouse for cord-free connectivity when you need it on the go. Designed to push the limits, the HP X3000 G3 Wireless Mouse goes the distance with you, with up to 15 months of use on a single AA battery (3). Compute with confidence, knowing your HP wireless mouse is protected by a 1-year limited warranty and 24/7 online support. (5) (1) Compatible with Windows® 10 and higher, Chrome, and Mac®. (2) Multi-surface sensor is not guaranteed to work on glass surfaces. (3) Battery life based on a 5-day week, 8 hours per day (active 4.3%, idle 4.1%, sleep 6.9%, deep sleep 84.7%); and 16 hours of sleep (100% deep sleep). The maximum capacity of the battery will naturally decrease with time and usage
